provenance.canonical-source: apps/v4/registry/new-york-v4/ui/card.tsx — the canonical variant for this registry, as in every previous column. Seven exported parts (Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardAction, CardContent, CardFooter), no cva, no variants object, no props beyond React.ComponentProps<"div">. Token values from apps/v4/app/globals.css. Composition read from apps/v4/registry/new-york-v4/examples/{card-demo,card-with-form}.tsx.
provenance.sibling-base-recorded-not-imported: apps/v4/registry/bases/radix/ui/card.tsx is NOT byte-identical to the canonical file and the difference is a PROP: it adds `size?: "default" | "sm"` (written out as data-size) and moves every visual class into `cn-card*` stylesheet classes not present in this clone. It also makes the header's second row conditional (`has-data-[slot=card-description]:grid-rows-[auto_auto]`) where the canonical file's is unconditional. Recorded here exactly as dialog.shadcn.json recorded alert-dialog's size prop, so a future reader does not import it across. The `base` and `aria` sibling variants likewise exist and are likewise not canonical.
provenance.surface-bg: card.tsx `bg-card` -> --color-card -> --card: oklch(1 0 0) light / oklch(0.205 0 0) dark. NOTE THE LIGHT VALUE: it is byte-identical to --background, so a resting shadcn card in light mode is the SAME COLOUR as the page and is separated from it by its border and shadow ALONE. In dark mode --card (0.205) is lighter than --background (0.145), so the tonal separation exists only there.
provenance.surface-fg: card.tsx `text-card-foreground` -> --card-foreground: oklch(0% 0 0) light / oklch(0.985 0 0) dark — identical to --foreground in BOTH modes, i.e. the class pins the ambient colour rather than changing it.
provenance.surface-border: card.tsx bare `border` — Tailwind's border utility with no colour utility beside it, so the width is Tailwind's undeclared 1px default (docs/foundations/border-style.md) and the colour comes from the preflight `--border` mapping: oklch(0.922 0 0) light / oklch(1 0 0 / 10%) dark.
provenance.shadow-sm: card.tsx `shadow-sm`. [R] — Tailwind is NOT vendored in this clone, so the two-layer value is Tailwind v4's own documented shadow-sm. Reused verbatim from tabs.shadcn.json rather than re-derived; the same unvendored-package caveat select.shadcn.json recorded for shadow-md and dialog.shadcn.json for shadow-lg. Mode-invariant, as all Tailwind shadows are. docs/foundations/elevation.md records that shadcn has no elevation foundation at all.
provenance.radius: card.tsx `rounded-xl` -> --radius-xl -> calc(var(--radius) * 1.4) = 0.625rem * 1.4 = 0.875rem = 14px. This is the ROUNDEST surface shadcn has in this registry: its dialog panel is rounded-lg (10px, the full --radius) and its controls are --radius-md (8px). Sourced from globals.css's own derived scale, not from Tailwind defaults.
provenance.spacing: every spacing number in the component is a Tailwind step on the 4px grid, read directly off the class strings: card `py-6 gap-6` = 24px block padding and a 24px gap between direct children, with NO horizontal padding of its own; CardHeader/CardContent/CardFooter each `px-6` = 24px; CardHeader `gap-2` = 8px. There is no shadcn spacing foundation to alias to (docs/foundations/spacing.md).
provenance.typography: the entire component declares ONE type size: CardDescription's `text-sm` (0.875rem/1.25rem). CardTitle is `leading-none font-semibold` — weight and line-height with NO font-size, so a card title is the same size as the text around it. The Card itself sets no type at all. There is no shadcn type-scale foundation (docs/foundations/typography.md), so these are read off the component's own classes.
provenance.no-interaction: CONFIRMED ABSENCE, checked by reading the whole file: card.tsx contains no hover:, focus:, focus-visible:, active:, aria-disabled:, data-[state=…] or disabled utility on any of its seven parts, no role, no tabIndex and no event handler. A shadcn card is inert. Every interaction row in this column is off for that reason, not for want of looking.
provenance.consumer-opt-in-dividers: CardHeader carries `[.border-b]:pb-6` and CardFooter `[.border-t]:pt-6` — padding that appears only when the CONSUMER adds a border class to that same element. It is a documented composition hook, not a component-owned divider, and is declared out of the chassis (docs/CARD-MATRIX.md declared approximation 5) rather than modelled, because the border itself is never applied by the component.
provenance.container-query: CardHeader is `@container/card-header`, i.e. it names a container-query context. Nothing in card.tsx queries it; it exists for consumers. Recorded, not modelled — the generator has no @container channel any more than it has an @media one (docs/INPUT-MATRIX.md finding 9).

structure.media.note: no dedicated part — card.tsx exports seven parts and none is media; the blocks place bare children. Recorded as an absence, same as the other two columns

structure.header.source: CardHeader — the most structured part of the three systems: a CSS grid with auto-rows-min, grid-rows-[auto_auto], items-start, a named container context and a conditional second column

structure.action.source: CardAction — col-start-2 row-span-2 row-start-1 self-start justify-self-end, and its presence rewires the header to grid-cols-[1fr_auto] through `has-data-[slot=card-action]`

structure.accent.note: CONFIRMED ABSENCE — no stripe, bar or leading-edge decoration of any kind

structure.state-layer.note: CONFIRMED ABSENCE — no overlay, and no interaction state to drive one

structure.card-icon.note: CONFIRMED ABSENCE — no card-level icon part or class

structure.group.note: CONFIRMED ABSENCE — no card group, no selection container

structure.sectioning.source: there is no detection: the card unconditionally carries `py-6 gap-6` and every section unconditionally carries `px-6`. A shadcn card therefore NEVER has horizontal padding of its own, and bare (unsectioned) children sit flush to its border — the exact inverse of Salt, whose card pads itself until it finds sections

behavior.role.note: CONFIRMED ABSENCE — card.tsx writes data-slot and className and nothing else. Not a container role, not a region, nothing

behavior.tab-stop.note: the card is never focusable; only its consumer-supplied children are

behavior.keyboard-activation.note: no key handler anywhere in the file

behavior.pointer-activation.note: no click handler anywhere in the file

behavior.disabled-handling.note: CONFIRMED ABSENCE — no disabled prop, class, attribute or utility on any part

behavior.nested-interactive.source: the one unambiguous answer of the three systems: a shadcn card is always a container of focusable children and never a control itself — card-demo puts a Button in CardAction and two more in CardFooter

prop.variant.note: CONFIRMED ABSENCE — card.tsx has no cva, no variants object and no props beyond React.ComponentProps<"div">. One card, one appearance. The sibling `bases/radix` file DOES add a size prop; see the sibling-base-recorded-not-imported provenance entry

prop.interaction.source: single-valued and confirmed: there is no interactive card in card.tsx and no sibling file in the new-york-v4 registry provides one

state.rest.value: 1px --border + shadow-sm + --card, which in LIGHT mode is the same colour as the page
state.rest.note: so a light-mode shadcn card is separated from its background by border and shadow alone

state.focus.note: CONFIRMED ABSENCE, with a structural cause — the card is never focusable

slot.action.note: DECLARED COMPOSITION to `button` — card-demo puts <Button variant="link">Sign Up</Button> here

slot.footer.note: DECLARED COMPOSITION to `button` — card-demo puts two full-width Buttons here and has to add `flex-col gap-2` per instance because CardFooter has no gap of its own

style.surface.color.note: the only system that colours its card's text; the value is identical to --foreground in both modes, so it pins rather than changes

style.surface.font.note: CONFIRMED ABSENCE — the Card sets no type size; only CardDescription does

style.surface.padding.source: `py-6` and NO px utility on the Card — the horizontal padding lives on the sections

style.surface.padding@sectioned.note: OFF deliberately, and it is the difference between "always" and "detected": shadcn's py-6 SURVIVES sectioning, where Salt's padding is handed over entirely

style.surface.gap.source: `gap-6` between every direct child of the card — a real gap, where Salt collapses the follower's top padding instead

style.surface.overflow.note: CONFIRMED ABSENCE — a shadcn card does NOT clip its media to its 14px corners

style.surface.elevation.note: [R] value, see the shadow-sm provenance entry

style.surface.transition.note: CONFIRMED ABSENCE — no transition utility, and nothing to transition to

style.media.box.note: no media part and no rule

style.header.padding.source: CardHeader `px-6`; the card's own py-6 supplies the block padding

style.header.gap.source: CardHeader `gap-2` — between the title row and the description row of its grid

style.title.type.source: CardTitle `leading-none font-semibold` — there is NO font-size, so a shadcn card title matches the surrounding text size and is distinguished by weight and leading alone. Contrast its own DialogTitle, which carries text-lg

style.description.type.source: CardDescription `text-sm` — the only type size in the whole component in any of the three systems

style.content.padding@adjacent.note: not needed — shadcn separates its sections with the card's own gap-6 rather than by collapsing padding

style.content.stretch.note: CONFIRMED ABSENCE — CardContent has no flex utility, so a shadcn card in a row of unequal cards does not stretch its body to align the footers the way a Salt one does

style.footer.stretch.note: OFF deliberately — no source rule pins shadcn's footer to the bottom, and inventing one would change where it sits in a card with an explicit height

style.footer.gap.note: CONFIRMED ABSENCE — CardFooter is `flex items-center px-6` with no gap; card-demo has to add `flex-col gap-2` per instance to space two buttons
